Code browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Code CMM2 Stereo Metal Mate Published on October 13, 2023 Code distortion pedal picture by Ed from Tone Machines Blog picture by Ed from Tone Machines Blog picture by Ed from Tone Machines Blog picture by Ed from Tone Machines Blog picture by Ed from Tone Machines Blog picture by Ed from Tone Machines Blog Information The CODE Metal Mate is a rare distortion pedal likely produced in the 1980s, featuring a unique tonal profile that sets it apart from other metal-style pedals of its era. Though often speculated to be a clone of the Boss HM-2 Heavy Metal, the Metal Mate delivers a more aggressive, mid-forward distortion reminiscent of a high-gain Rat rather than the extreme saturation of typical death metal pedals. It offers a four-knob layout consisting of Level, Distortion, High, and Low controls. The High knob functions similarly to a lowpass filter, offering a smooth, sweeping response in the upper frequencies, while the Low control delivers a full, punchy low end. The Distortion knob provides a wide gain range, and the Level knob controls the overall output volume. Although labeled as a stereo pedal, the unit includes two outputs: one wet and one dry, allowing for simple parallel signal routing. Controls Level: Adjusts the overall output volume Distortion: Sets the amount of gain/saturation High: Shapes upper frequency content with a smooth, filter-like sweep Low: Enhances or reduces low-end response Connections Input jack Wet output jack Dry output jack Technical Specifications Not specified Highlights 1980s-era distortion pedal with aggressive, mid-forward voicing Dual output configuration for wet/dry signal routing Smooth high-frequency control and deep bass response Distinct tonal identity apart from typical metal distortion circuits Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Links Code CMM2 Stereo Metal Mate (Tone Machines Blog) Related Electra 608HM Metal Max Code CMM2 Stereo Metal Mate (different enclosure, same PCB) Omnifex 708HM Metal Max Solec HM-841 Stereo Heavy Metal Where to find one?
